name: mark, wordmark and cta inside a soft ring
looks: A small square app icon sits inside a faint expanding ring on a pale field. The brand name and a short tagline fade up beneath it, then a solid CTA button and a plain url appear side by side, with a small platform list underneath.
build: The ring is a thin stroked circle scaling up from the icon on power2.out with fading opacity. The wordmark and tagline reveal with a clipPath wipe; the CTA button is a DOM pill with a solid fill that pops in on back.out(1.6); the url and platform list fade up last, staggered 0.08s apart.
sound: A soft chime as the ring settles, a swell under the wordmark, a confirm tone on the button's pop, fading out over the hold.
prompt: Close on a small app mark inside a faint expanding ring, with the brand name and a short tagline fading up beneath it, then a solid call-to-action button and a plain web address appearing together, with a short platform list fading in last. Hold the finished card.
